scientific_integrity: The work provides self-contained proofs and finite reproducibility checks. Its originality is a literature-based assessment with unresolved risk of equivalent presentations in truncated tensor-algebra literature. No independent mathematical validation or claim of comprehensive literature coverage is made.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the free nilpotent nonunital Zinbiel algebra of class two, not arbitrary Zinbiel algebras. Gaussian multiplicities count embedded subspaces and ideals; the separate isomorphism-type totals do not count automorphism orbits. Direct exhaustive checks cover prime fields of size two and three at generator dimensions one and two; the general statement follows from a characteristic-free tensor-space proof.
title: Subalgebra and ideal Grassmannians of free class-two Zinbiel algebras
